sources.notes: Files: YYMMDD_rpts_hail.csv, _wind.csv, _torn.csv (preliminary, local-storm-report based). Hail size in hundredths of an inch; wind speed in mph (UNK = damage report with no measured speed). Lane storm-lead raises the daily budget to 2000 for the 24-month backtest; the fetcher cache makes re-runs free.
